pairs.question: Sospes anne est vester Columba sanctus pater?
pairs.answer: Vere salvus est noster ille patronus, qui his diebus nuper ad Christum commigravit.
pairs.derivation: Columb Crag questions the two arriving monks. Stripped the mid-utterance speech tag 'ait Columb Crag' (yielding contiguous 'Sospes anne est vester Columba sanctus pater?') and the answer's narration 'Qui valde illacrymati, cum magno dixerunt maerore,'. The reply directly answers the yes/no question ('Vere salvus est...'); kept whole to its full stop. All words verbatim and contiguous.

pairs.question: Quem post se successorem reliquit?
pairs.derivation: Fintenus asks who Columba left as successor. Stripped the framing 'Fintenus consequenter percunctatur dicens:' and the mid-answer tag 'aieunt' (yielding contiguous 'Baitheneum, suum alumnum.'). Direct answer naming the successor. No interior ellipsis; words verbatim.

pairs.question: Quid ad haec, Fintene, facies?
pairs.answer: Si Dominus permiserit, ad Baitheneum virum sanctum et sapientem enavigabo et si me susceperit, ipsum abbatem habebo.
pairs.derivation: The monk Columba asks Fintenus what he will do. Stripped the framing 'Columba ad Fintenum inquit:' and the answer's tag 'Qui respondens ait:'. Fintenus's reply directly answers what he will do; kept whole to its full stop, before 'Tum deinde supra memoratum Columb osculatus...'.

pairs.question: Quis hac die valde ventosa et nimis periculosa, licet breve, fretum prospere transnavigare potest?
pairs.answer: Cuidam sancto et electo homini, qui ad nos ante vesperam perveniet, Omnipotens tranquillitatem, quamlibet in tempestate, donavit.
pairs.derivation: A brother asks who could cross the strait on so stormy a day. Stripped the mid-utterance tag 'aie' (yielding contiguous 'Quis hac die... transnavigare potest?') and the answer's framing 'Quo audito Sanctus sic profatur:'. The Saint's reply answers (a holy man, to whom God has granted calm, will reach them); kept to its full stop, before 'Et ecce, eadem die...'.

pairs.question: Numquid hac in hora tibi aliqua formidabilis ostensa visio est?
pairs.answer: Tam terrifica ultio nunc in remota orbis parte peracta est.
pairs.derivation: Lugbeus asks whether the Saint has had a fearful vision. Stripped the framing 'audet Sanctum interrogare, inquiens,' before the question and 'Cui Sanctus talem dedit responsionem:' before the answer. The reply directly answers (a terrible vengeance has been carried out); kept to its full stop, before Lugbeus's next question 'Qualis... vindicta'.

pairs.question: Qualis vindicta, et in qua regione facta?
pairs.answer: Sulfurea de coelo flamma super Romani juris civitatem, intra Italiae terminos sitam, hac hora effusa est; triaque ferme millia virorum, excepto matrum puerorumque numero disperierunt.
pairs.derivation: The young man asks what kind of vengeance and where. Stripped the mid-utterance tag 'ait juvenis' (yielding contiguous 'Qualis vindicta, et in qua regione facta?') and the answer's framing 'Sanctus tum sic profatur:'. The reply directly answers (sulphurous fire on an Italian city, with the toll); kept through its full stop, before 'Et antequam praesens finiatur annus...'.

pairs.locus: Adomnan, Vita Sancti Columbae 1, De Alicujus Plebeii Familiola
pairs.question: Ubi habitas?
pairs.answer: In regione quae littoribus stagni Crogreth est contermina ego inhabito.
pairs.derivation: The Saint asks the plebeian where he lives. Stripped the framing 'ait,' after 'Ubi' and the answer's tag 'Ille inquit,'. Direct answer naming his region; kept to its full stop, before 'Illam quam dicis provinciolam...'.

pairs.locus: Adomnan, Vita Sancti Columbae 1, De Quodam Plebeio Goreo
pairs.question: Quare de meo interfectore mihi nunc intimare non vis?
pairs.answer: Idcirco nolo tibi de illo tuo comite nocuo nunc manifestius aliquid edicere, ne te ejus crebra recogniti recordatio nimis maestificet, donec illa veniat dies qua ejusdem rei veritatem probabis.
pairs.derivation: Goreus asks why the Saint will not reveal his future killer. Stripped 'Goreus inquit,' from the question (yielding contiguous 'Quare de meo interfectore mihi nunc intimare non vis?') and 'Sanctus, ... ait,' from the answer (the mid-utterance 'Idcirco, ait, nolo' becomes contiguous 'Idcirco nolo'). The reply directly answers why he withholds the name; kept whole to its full stop, before 'Quid immoramur verbis?'.

pairs.locus: Adomnan, Vita Sancti Columbae 1, De Bello in Munitione Cethirni
pairs.question: Qua causa ejus fontana corrumpetur unda?
pairs.derivation: Comgellus asks why the spring's water will be corrupted. Stripped the mid-utterance tag 'ait Comgellus' (yielding contiguous 'Qua causa ejus fontana corrumpetur unda?') and the answer's framing 'Sanctus tum Columba, ... inquit,' (the mid-utterance 'Quia humano, inquit, cruore replebitur' becomes contiguous 'Quia humano cruore replebitur'). Answer is the operative first sentence directly answering the cause; stopped before the elaboration 'nam mei cognationales amici...'.
